chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Pasadena, 1994: the World Cup final. Italy’s captain, Franco Baresi, had knee surgery just weeks before. Here’s how he defended. Dunga looks for Romário… but Baresi gets there first!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Baresi watches Dunga, not just the ball. He guesses the pass is for Romário, so he moves early… and steps in front!

chapters.label: Ball won
chapters.text: Ball won! Baresi lifts his head and starts Italy’s attack with a long pass. In two hours of football, Brazil never scored.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s Baresi. Guess where the pass is going, and get there first!
